Command `cat > /workspace/analysis.json <<'JSON'
{"sample_id":"arvo_12953",
 "fine_trace":[
   {"step":1,"file":"suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasm.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput",
    "line":235,"var":"Data","code":"size_t count = cs_disasm(handle, Data+1, Size-1, address, 0, &all_insn);",
    "role":"source",
    "note":"Input bytes from fuzzer are passed to cs_disasm for TMS320C64X disassembly"},
   {"step":2,"file":"arch/TMS320C64x/TMS320C64xDisassembler.c","function":"TMS320C64x_getInstruction",
    "line":599,"var":"insn","code":"insn = (code[3] << 0) | (code[2] << 8) | (code[1] << 16) | (code[0] << 24);",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Input bytes are assembled into a 32-bit instruction word for decoding"},
   {"step":3,"file":"suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasm.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput",
    "line":245,"var":"i->id","code":"cs_insn_name(handle, i->id)",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"The decoded instruction id is passed to cs_insn_name which dispatches to TMS320C64x_insn_name"},
   {"step":4,"file":"arch/TMS320C64x/TMS320C64xMapping.c","function":"TMS320C64x_insn_name",
    "line":1739,"var":"id","code":"if (id >= TMS320C64X_INS_ENDING) return NULL;",
    "role":"root_cause",
    "note":"Bounds check compares id against TMS320C64X_INS_ENDING (very large) but insn_name_maps array only has 3 entries; should check id < ARR_SIZE(insn_name_maps)"},
   {"step":5,"file":"arch/TMS320C64x/TMS320C64xMapping.c","function":"TMS320C64x_insn_name",
    "line":1748,"var":"insn_name_maps[id]","code":"return insn_name_maps[id].name;",
    "role":"sink",
    "note":"Out-of-bounds global buffer read: id >= 3 exceeds the 3-element insn_name_maps array"}
 ],
 "vuln_logic":{
   "source":{"file":"suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasm.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput",
     "line":235,"operands":["Data+1"]},
   "root_cause":{"file":"arch/TMS320C64x/TMS320C64xMapping.c","function":"TMS320C64x_insn_name",
     "line":1739,"operands":["id","ARR_SIZE(insn_name_maps)"],
     "relation":{"op":"lt","left":"id","right":"ARR_SIZE(insn_name_maps)"}},
   "sink":{"file":"arch/TMS320C64x/TMS320C64xMapping.c","function":"TMS320C64x_insn_name",
     "line":1748,"operands":["id","3"],
     "relation":{"op":"lt","left":"id","right":"3"}},
   "propagation":[
     {"from":{"file":"suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasm.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput",
       "line":235,"operands":["Data+1"]},
      "to":{"file":"arch/TMS320C64x/TMS320C64xDisassembler.c","function":"TMS320C64x_getInstruction",
       "line":599,"operands":["insn"]},
      "type":"data","via":["cs_disasm","code"]},
     {"from":{"file":"arch/TMS320C64x/TMS320C64xDisassembler.c","function":"TMS320C64x_getInstruction",
       "line":599,"operands":["insn"]},
      "to":{"file":"suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasm.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput",
       "line":245,"operands":["i->id"]},
      "type":"data","via":["decodeInstruction_4","MCInst"]},
     {"from":{"file":"suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasm.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput",
       "line":245,"operands":["i->id"]},
      "to":{"file":"arch/TMS320C64x/TMS320C64xMapping.c","function":"TMS320C64x_insn_name",
       "line":1748,"operands":["id"]},
      "type":"data","via":["cs_insn_name","handle->insn_name"]}
   ]
 }}
JSON` executed with exit code 0.
